title: AAOIFI Clause Record
description: Structure for one clause extracted from a researcher-supplied AAOIFI standard. This schema contains no AAOIFI clause data.

standard_id.description: Identifier of the in-scope AAOIFI Shari'ah Standard.

section_id.description: Section identifier as printed in the source standard.

clause_id.description: Clause identifier as printed in the source standard.

occurrence_index.description: Zero-based source-order occurrence for repeated standard_id plus clause_id pairs. It preserves source-faithful clause numbering while making repeated printed identifiers addressable.

sub_clause_id.description: Sub-clause identifier when the source standard defines one; otherwise null.

text.description: Verbatim clause text retained only in the private corpus.

source_page.description: One-based PDF page number when available; otherwise null.

disagreement_tag.description: Reserved for a future qualified-expert review process. It must remain null in Stage 1; no simulated or placeholder values are permitted.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp recording the most recent change to this private record.
